rationale: K=3 shared-weight iterated U-Net + BF (epochs=5 to fit budget). val 0.6515 vs iter-5 best 0.6568 (-0.8%). K=3 is too deep at constant params; the same SmallUNet applied 3x can't carry the inductive bias for a 3-stage refinement. Possible alternative: K=3 with epochs=8 needs ~470s train but val likely improves. Reverting to K=2 / epochs=6.
advice_for_others: Shared-weight K=3 underperforms K=2 at constant 5-min budget — the marginal benefit of an extra iteration is eaten by the 2 fewer training epochs needed to fit time.
